name: capture_session_create
title: Create a footage session
description: Create a project-scoped Footage session for a bucket of recordings captured across one real-world period. The session starts without a master recording, reserves one stable editable episode handle, and can receive more files or device folders later. Follow with upload_link_create(capture_session_id: ...) for local or contributor uploads, then capture_session_read while chronology analysis settles.

project_id.description: Project public ID that owns the Footage session.

title.description: Short human title, such as Park coaching · Jul 15.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable key for safe retry of this exact creation request.

episode_id.description: Stable episode handle reserved for the eventual editable projection.
